patterns.rationale: Generic mock-data filler the V5 era engine emitted in name columns; later iterations banned it. Captured as one example of the workshop-theme leak class.

patterns.pattern: /(?:Annual MOT compliance|Brake pad replacement|Customer aftercare check|Stock photography upload|Finance application review)/
patterns.rationale: Workshop-themed filler strings that historically leaked into people-shaped columns. Generic ban: any shipped clone output that contains workshop-shop task names where a person's name should appear is wrong.

Concatenated PascalCase column header (e.g. ResetEmail, UserLevel) — symptom of stripped whitespace between words. Live captured 'Reset Email' as two tokens; the V6/V7 era rendered it as one. Generic class: any shipped <th> containing 2+ camel-glued words is a label-whitespace regression.
Empty wrapper table — V7 era saw the renderer emit a 1x1 layout-wrapper alongside the real grid. Generic class: any shipped <table> with empty thead and empty tbody is a duplicate-wrapper regression.

Performance-rating string that leaked into checkbox-shaped columns (Add Vehicle / Confirm Sale / etc.). V8's audit Gate 16 caught this; CI seeds the ban so any shipped clone HTML containing 'Above Average' OUTSIDE a performance-dashboard context is wrong. NOTE: legitimate performance columns will need to allowlist this string when audit Gate 16 lands.

The same person's name leaking into Active Salesperson / Default Salesperson / Manager columns simultaneously is the canonical input-kind-vs-value mismatch signature. Generic class: two consecutive <td> with identical full-name content in user-admin tables.

patterns.pattern: /<th[^>]*>(?:Add Vehicle|Confirm Sale|Change Price|Cancel Order|Show SIV|Two[-\s]?Factor|Active Sales|Default Sales|Performance (?:Admin|Targets)|Block|Hide Purchase)<\/th>(?:[\s\S](?!<input))*?<td[^>]*>(?:[A-Z][a-z]+ ){1,3}[A-Z][a-z]+<\/td>/
patterns.rationale: A checkbox-shaped column header (Add Vehicle / Confirm Sale / etc.) followed by a multi-word person name in the corresponding td. Generic class: action-verb header + name value is a kind mismatch. (R20: the regex is conservative; false positives unlikely in shipped clone HTML.)

Capture-time check: a live manifest leaf with a 'Please Note' paragraph in its DOM should produce a pageInfoBanners entry. This regex pattern is observational only — failure to match is normal; presence indicates banner content was captured.

Manifest cell that is empty-but-currency-shaped (em-dash, --, N/A). Generic class: column-semantic-mismatch where a currency column renders no digits. Pattern is observational; the audit's column-semantic check uses it to find candidate offenders.
Manifest cell in a date-shaped column that doesn't match any of the V8 date patterns. Generic class: column-semantic mismatch where a date column shows a non-date value. Pattern is observational.
